questions.q: What menu path starts a new Reporting Services project in Visual Studio?
options: Build > New Project
Tools > New Reporting Project
Extensions > New Report
File > New > Project, then select Report Server Project
questions.explain: In Visual Studio, you go to File > New > Project and select (or search for) the Report Server Project template.

questions.q: What's the difference between the Report Server Project and Report Server Project Wizard templates?
options: Report Server Project can only hold one report, but the Wizard version can hold many
Report Server Project Wizard is only for SharePoint mode
Report Server Project starts empty; Report Server Project Wizard creates the project and immediately opens a guided report wizard
They are identical, just named differently
questions.explain: Report Server Project gives you an empty project you build by hand; Report Server Project Wizard automatically creates the project and walks you through building your first report.

questions.q: If Report Server Project doesn't appear in your template list, what should you do first?
options: Install the SSRS extension for Visual Studio (via Extensions > Manage Extensions, or the SQL Server Data Tools workload)
Switch to Report Builder permanently — SSDT can't be fixed
Reinstall Windows
Create the project as a Console App instead
questions.explain: SSDT doesn't include Reporting Services templates by default — you need to install the SSRS extension for Visual Studio (or add the SQL Server Data Tools workload) first.

questions.q: What three folders does Solution Explorer organize a fresh Report Server Project into?
options: Debug, Release, DebugLocal
Data, Reports, Output
Folders, KPIs, Resources
Shared Data Sources, Shared Datasets, Reports
questions.explain: A new report server project's Solution Explorer groups files into Shared Data Sources, Shared Datasets, and Reports folders.

questions.q: How do you add a new report (.rdl file) to the Reports folder?
options: Right-click the Reports folder, choose Add > New Item, select the Report template, and name it ending in .rdl
Use the Build menu's Deploy Solution command
Reports can only be added through the Report Server Project Wizard
Drag a .rdl file from the report server's web portal into Visual Studio
questions.explain: Right-clicking the Reports folder and choosing Add > New Item, then selecting Report and naming it with a .rdl extension, is how a new report file gets added and opened in Design view.
